apply · destroy
manual · main branch only
• assume role via OIDC
• Terraform 1.11.4
• apply or plan -destroy
destroy hides its plan from the log

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #232F3E; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Workflow hardening
• Third-party actions pinned by commit SHA
• contents: read; id-token: write only in apply/destroy
• No pull_request_target: fork PRs get no secrets
• One concurrency group, never cancelled mid-run
• Account ID masked; no state or plan uploaded as artifact

div.div:
Repository secrets
• AWS_ROLE_ARN → role to assume
• OPENAI_API_KEY → sensitive, ephemeral variable
• ALERT_EMAIL → alert subscription
Passed only to the Terraform step as TF_VAR_*, never on the command line.
